name: Walter
source:
Role: Chancellor
Likes: "A good drink now and then"
Dislikes: Superstition
Alliance: Bastion

Chancellor of Bastion and also a decorated war hero, Walter commands unequivocal respect from his soldiers. Despite his imposing appearance, Walter possesses quite an avuncular personality. As such, he is particularly popular among women and young children. A pragmatic man, he wields a claymore to crush his enemies.

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
